Authorized Chunks Only"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge4" edge="1" parent="1" source="node4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="node5" value="Structured JSON Payload"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pillars" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=#B3B3B3;fillColor=#f9f9f9;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=1;spacing=15;" value="<b>KEY ARCHITECTURAL PILLARS:</b><br><br>1. <b>Shift-Left Security:</b> Enforces data isolation directly at the database index layer using PostgreSQL JSONB intersection checks (?|), ensuring unauthorized records never enter application memory.<br>2. <b>Hardware Constraint Resolution:</b> Truncates 3072d vectors to 1536d using Matryoshka embeddings, bypassing the 2000-dimension HNSW indexing ceiling while retaining 98%+ semantic accuracy.<br>3. <b>Deterministic API Contracts:</b> Wraps non-deterministic LLM synthesis in strongly-typed Pydantic DTOs with citation verification and cosine confidence scoring." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="940" x="120" y="580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
KEY ARCHITECTURAL PILLARS:
1. Shift-Left Security: Enforces data isolation directly at the database index layer using PostgreSQL JSONB intersection checks (?|), ensuring unauthorized records never enter application memory.
2. Hardware Constraint Resolution: Truncates 3072d vectors to 1536d using Matryoshka embeddings, bypassing the 2000-dimension HNSW indexing ceiling while retaining 98%+ semantic accuracy.
3. Deterministic API Contracts: Wraps non-deterministic LLM synthesis in strongly-typed Pydantic DTOs with citation verification and cosine confidence scoring.
